messages:
acme-corp: Hey, seeing intermittent 502s + occasional 401s in the Console when opening a conversation. Happens in Chrome and Safari. Example timestamp UTC 2024-05-03T14:12:05Z. Response header included x-request-id: req_3f2a9c. Can you share repro capture steps?

maria (Support): thanks for the report — we can escalate but need HAR + console logs + a curl repro to triage. Below are compact, cross-browser steps. Please include the x-request-id and the exact local time when you saw the failure.

maria (Support): Chrome / Edge (desktop) — easiest:
1) Open the Console/Network devtools (Mac: Cmd+Option+I, Win: F12).
2) Network tab -> check "Preserve log".
3) Reproduce the error.
4) Right-click the network list -> "Save all as HAR with content" (or "Export HAR"). This includes request/response headers and bodies.
5) Console tab -> filter "Errors" and right-click -> "Save as..." or copy visible logs.
6) In the network list right-click the failing request -> "Copy" -> "Copy as cURL" and paste that into the ticket (replace the Authorization value with REDACTED).

maria (Support): Firefox (desktop):
- DevTools (F12) -> Network -> click the gear and enable "Persist Logs" -> reproduce -> right-click -> "Save all as HAR". Also copy console errors.

maria (Support): Safari (desktop) — note: older Safari doesn't always export HAR directly. Try this:
- Preferences -> Advanced -> enable "Show Develop menu".
- Develop -> Show Web Inspector -> Network tab. Click the round record button, reproduce.
- If you see an "Export"/"Export HAR" option in the Network pane, use that. If not available, either: (a) use Chrome/Edge to repro if possible, (b) use a proxy tool (Charles, Fiddler, mitmproxy) to capture the session and export HAR, or (c) use macOS Console + the Web Inspector network table -> right-click requests -> "Copy as cURL" for the failing request.

maria (Support): Mobile repro? Use remote debugging (Chrome remote debugging for Android, Safari remote Web Inspector for iOS) or capture via proxy (Charles/mitmproxy). If you can't use those, record a short video and note the exact timestamp.

maria (Support): Important: before uploading, please redact any secrets. Specifically: replace Authorization: Bearer <token> with Authorization: REDACTED. We need the request/response headers (so we can read x-request-id), timings, and server response body.

maria (Support): How to provide curl + verbose output (helpful): after you "Copy as cURL", paste here the single-line curl and also run:

  curl --compressed -v '<paste-url>' -H 'Authorization: REDACTED' \
    --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code} %{time_total}s'

maria (Support): Where to upload: zip the HAR + console logs + the redacted curl snippet and upload to https://uploads.redwood.ai/support (or reply here with a link). If the file is large, a Google Drive/Dropbox link is fine.

acme-corp: Uploaded a 4.3MB file to the support url (link: https://uploads.redwood.ai/xyz/har-req3f2a9c.zip). I redacted the token. Also attached curl.

jessica (Support): got it, downloading now. Can you confirm which region this org is hitting (us-west-2 / eu-west-1)? Also any SSO / org-wide rate limits enabled?

acme-corp: us-west-2. No org rate limits configured on our side. SSO via OIDC.

jessica (Support): thanks — I'm escalating to eng and attaching the HAR. tagging @axel.

axel (Eng): looking. initial quick checks: x-request-id header present, downstream shows 502 from our inference tier at 2024-05-03T14:12:05Z. Can you re-run the failing curl with --trace-ascii / -v and paste the headers? Also what was the client User-Agent?

acme-corp: re-ran and added output to the upload: curl_verbose.txt (shows UA: Mozilla/5.0 (... Chrome/115.0)).

axel (Eng): perfect — two follow-ups: (1) please try the curl but add header 'x-debug=1' so we can get expanded logs for the request on our side (we'll only log when we see that header), (2) if you can reproduce in Chrome, please attach the HAR again but ensure the failing request is top of list so we can more easily find it.

acme-corp: will try x-debug=1 and re-upload.

qa-bot: Note: If x-debug=1 is used, engineering will only keep the expanded logs for 72 hours. Do not include real tokens.

maria (Support): appreciate the quick turnaround. Once you upload the new set with x-debug header, we'll link to the eng trace and follow up with remediation/next steps. :thumbsup:

acme-corp: uploaded new HAR + curl with x-debug=1 (link: https://uploads.redwood.ai/xyz/har-req3f2a9c-debug.zip). Let us know if you need anything else.

axel (Eng): received — commencing deep-dive. If we need a live session we'll ping for a screenshare and reproduction window. For now, this set is excellent.

maria (Support): closing the loop here — thanks for the quick repro. We'll update this thread when eng has a root cause. If anything else happens, drop the new x-request-id and time here.

acme-corp: thanks everyone!"
